evidence.model_evidence: The live retrieval evidence consists of Bing search engine results for 10 site-specific queries targeting German job boards and QA/test terms. Analysis of the returned URLs and snippets shows that they do not expose any real direct vacancy cards or APIs for QA/testing in Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany-wide remote. The results are limited to generic informational pages (e.g., Wikipedia articles on 'Qualitätssicherung', 'QA', 'Softwaretest', 'Testautomatisierung'), educational blogs (e.g., t3n.de, qytera.de, imbus.de), or search landing pages of other aggregators (e.g., stepstone.de/jobs/softwaretester) rather than actual direct job vacancy cards from the queried sites. Consequently, no new sources can be added, and no existing sources are verified as exposing direct vacancy cards through this specific search evidence.
